summary: Read-only contract review confirms that the exact unchanged d31b source-pixel adapter and accepted5b59 composition can express ordered long/short window comparisons using unique stations plus an external caller manifest. No new CV math or source change is needed. The contract preserves mandatory source/crop controls and all null/nonfinite/visibility states; it forbids interpreting local fits as continuous edge identity. No CV execution was performed.

artifacts.role: Bounded input/output contract, six independently switchable ablations, twelve adversarial checks, and explicit scientific limits

principalFindings: A window with fewer than eight generated t samples is structurally unable to fit under the unchanged source guard; null is not physical edge absence.
Keep origin/heading fixed for a window-only comparison. Dev72 ignores t0/t1, so repeated same-pose sensor rows are duplicated observations, not longitudinal corroboration.
Parent/control/window-order metadata belongs outside the frozen adapter request: unsupported station keys cause pre-operation UNKNOWN.
Visible counts are aggregate per normal offset; fitted left and right edges may draw support from different t subsets. No simultaneous per-t bilateral claim follows.
Finite short-window pairs may switch between competing bright structures; midpoint similarity or an expected lateral shift does not solve association.
Mandatory original-source and crop receipts, fixed equivalence tolerance and every disagreement remain required. Exact pixels alone cannot establish numerical output invariance.
freshnessAndExposure: All old cases are exposed. This review inspected prior documentation/evidence declarations but ran no source pixels or fitter. New visual declarations and any later runs remain exploratory rather than blind heldout evaluation.
nextBoundary: Root may use this critique to freeze the bounded caller protocol. This result itself does not authorize a CV run, alter a source, or accept scientific identity/width/continuity.
